sloka: अथ दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णमुपस्थितम् ।तूर्णमुत्थाय संहृष्टः सन्निकर्षमुपानयत् ।। ६.६२.७ ।।
transliteration: atha dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇamupasthitam ।tūrṇamutthāya saṁhṛṣṭaḥ sannikarṣamupānayat ।। 6.62.7 ।।

translations.english: The ten headed Ravana seeing Kumbhakarna, was delighted and got up quickly and made him come close to him.
